blocking_issues.issue: The report attributes 4.67% (2Y), 4.94% (10Y) and 5.29% (30Y) to the official U.S. Treasury September 18 close. The Treasury's Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates for 2026 instead show September 18 values of 4.24% (2Y), 4.93% (10Y) and 5.34% (30Y). Because these values anchor the report's central financing-conditions thesis and an explicit chart, the mismatch is publication-blocking.
